content: MXC — Micro-Execution Container (Hyper-V & AI Agent Sandboxes) Hardware-isolated Windows 11, Windows Server 2025, and autonomous AI agent micro-VMs at container speed — <= 5 ms hot dispatch, 9s stripped Win11 cold boot, airgapped VMBus execution, and 100% immutable golden parent sterility. Rust (mxc-sdk / wxc-exec) Python 3.15 Hyper-V Gen2 (VMBus / PowerShell Direct) Windows 11 Pro & Server 2025 Multi-Tier Standby Pools TLS SNI Predictive Wake SIDPA / PMBOK 8 Governance Menno Drescher architected and built MXC (Micro-Execution Container) (https://github.com/mdresch/mxc), a multi-tier hardware containment and micro-VM execution fabric designed for untrusted autonomous AI agents, native Windows 11 / Windows Server 2025 workloads, and regulated EU enterprises. Unlike Docker containers—which share the host OS kernel and struggle with native Windows 11 or Win32 workloads—MXC unifies 10 containment backends (including Type-1 Hyper-V Gen2 micro-VMs, Windows ProcessContainer, Windows Sandbox, and WSLC) under a single declarative Rust CLI/SDK (wxc-exec / mxc-sdk). Hyper-V sandboxes run airgapped by default (0 network adapters), execute commands and file transfers over VMBus (PowerShell Direct), store zero credentials inside the guest, and guarantee 100% session sterility via immutable golden VHDX parents and transient differencing disks. Verified milestones: 9/9 Epics delivered across Phase 1 and Phase 2 with 271/271 automated tests passing (188 Python contract tests + 83 Rust SDK Hyper-V unit tests); Multi-Tier Standby Pools with HotRunning <= 5 ms dispatch (1.5 ms measured), WarmPaused <= 250 ms unpause (~215 ms), and ColdSaved (0.0 MB host RAM on NVMe); Lean Windows 11 Pro Agent image built unattended from ISO with 90 consumer AppX packages and Explorer stripped, 12-tool polyglot agent stack pre-baked, achieving a 9-second cold boot; live 5-Act verification including instant Hyper-V checkpoint rollback; aligned with EU AI Act Annex III (December 2, 2027 per Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) and ISO/IEC 42001.

metadata.title: MXC — Micro-Execution Container (Hyper-V & AI Agent Sandboxes)
metadata.description: Hardware-isolated Windows 11, Windows Server 2025, and autonomous AI agent micro-VMs at container speed — <= 5 ms hot dispatch, 9s stripped Win11 cold boot, airgapped VMBus execution, and 100% immutable golden parent sterility.
challenges: Resolving the enterprise trilemma between shared-kernel Docker blast radius, 14–45s traditional Windows VM cold boots, and 24/7 idle Windows Server licensing/RAM burn.
Executing untrusted autonomous AI agent workloads with zero network exposure and zero secrets inside the guest OS.
Guaranteeing 100% session sterility across ephemeral runs without mutating golden base images.

Solution: Built a Type-1 Hyper-V Generation 2 control plane in Rust (wxc-exec / mxc-sdk) using airgapped VMBus (PowerShell Direct), transient .avhdx differencing disks with instant checkpoint rollback, multi-tier Hot/Warm/Cold standby pools, and TLS SNI predictive wake.
